title: Screen collapses to a horizontal bar
backstory: Suddenly the whole screen has collapsed into a bright horizontal line near the middle. The game is still running — you can hear the attract music.
visible_effect: MAME framebuffer shows only a slim horizontal strip; top and bottom are blacked out by Lua overlay
diagnosis_hint: Vertical collapse almost always points to the vertical output IC or its associated electrolytic caps. On a Wells-Gardner 19K6100, check C412 (vertical coupling) and IC U3 (vertical deflection).
